'''Dromund Tyne''' was a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] occupying the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Dromund]] within the [[Dromund system]].<ref name="2Peas" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within a region known as the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dromund Tyne was first mentioned in the online article [[The Dark Forces Saga]], Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod released on [[Wizards.com]] on [[June 9]], [[2005]], written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="2Peas" />
